policy.fabricMappings: Minecraft 26.1.x Fabric/Quilt builds use Fabric Loom without mappings/remap dependencies because the game is distributed in the official namespace.
policy.neoforgeMetadata: NeoForge modLoader=javafml uses loaderVersion [1,), while the NeoForge runtime dependency range is derived from neoforge_runtime_min_version plus neoforge_accept_beta=true.
policy.minecraftRuntimeMetadata: Minecraft dependency ranges for Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge are derived from minecraft_runtime_min_version, minecraft_runtime_max_version and minecraft_accept_beta=true. This accepts beta runtimes such as 26.1.2-0-beta and later stable runtimes before the next profile boundary.

fabric.notes: Fabric-compatible build using Fabric Loader and Fabric API on the 26.1.x official namespace path with derived beta-compatible Minecraft dependency metadata.

quilt.notes: Quilt-compatible artifact reusing Fabric entrypoint and Fabric API on the 26.1.x official namespace path with derived beta-compatible Minecraft dependency metadata.

forge.notes: ForgeGradle 7 userdev build for the matching 26.1.x Forge line with derived beta-compatible Minecraft dependency metadata.

neoforge.notes: NeoForge ModDev build with javafml loader range, derived beta-compatible Minecraft dependency metadata and derived beta-compatible NeoForge runtime dependency range.

compatibilityGuards.gamerules: reflective daylight gamerule resolver with ADVANCE_TIME/DO_DAYLIGHT_CYCLE fallback
compatibilityGuards.serverTicks: reflective tick de-duplication for per-level events
